recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Further core source work is unnecessary for FHIR-53062 unless the work group separately wants an editorial reorganization of the remaining Organization example hierarchy outside the Notes section.
issue_request: FHIR-53062 was Applied/Persuasive with Modification for the Patient Administration work group. It asked to remove or edit Organization section 8.6.5 Notes because root Organization.address and Organization.telecom were removed in R5 and Organization.contact is now the single location for organization contact details.
initial_application: The issue appears to have been applied by commit b57689e1ee16b2eb83ef3d27ee6a0b85d74157d8, which removed the obsolete contact-information bullet from source/organization/organization-notes.xml. That commit is already an ancestor of the combined branch but did not contain an Issue-Reconcile-Key audit trailer.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively includes Organization as a current resource, so the Organization narrative source is in build scope. source/organization/structuredefinition-Organization.xml has Organization.contact and no root Organization.address or Organization.telecom elements. PA minutes from 2025-10-21 record approval of FHIR-53062, and focused Zulip/community searches found no conflicting discussion. The old copied note text remains only inside XML comments in InsurancePlan/InsuranceProduct notes and is not implementer-visible Organization guidance.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was needed because the stale implementer-visible Organization contact note is already absent from active source, while the remaining Organization Notes content is an example hierarchy rather than the obsolete contact guidance that triggered the issue.

related_jiras.note: The same historical commit also changed Location guidance, but that is a separate Location issue and was not evaluated or decided here.
